title: Black Airship Flies Festival 2026
summary: The opportunity to see dozens of fully colored balloon balloons flying over the Black Highland Sky (Kon Tum) early 2026.
body:
The rendezvous point of the giant flying balls

The 2026 Black air balloon festival is expected to take place on the first time of the year, which comprising many water and international balloons. Tourists will be allowed to fly balloons that view the entire forest, lake, and town of Black Hand from above.

- Rise and shine.
- Night balloon exhibit (night balloon)
- Cultural activities, French food.

**TodayTourist** has full package tour, booking hotels and experienced guides.
